title: 写字楼租金价格战：恒隆出租率超80%，杭州塔楼改零售能否稳住？
speaker: Adriel Chan

segments.en: So what's the top to stabilizing office rents in, say, the next 12, 18 months? That is the question. If I'm honest, I see a path. I don't know if it's 12 or 18 months, it may be longer than that in mainland China.
segments.zh: 那么，未来12到18个月写字楼租金何时企稳？这是个问题。坦白说，我看到了一条路径，但不确定是12还是18个月，在内地可能更长。

segments.en: It's been a very slow slog. It's been tough. And right now, it's a very much price war game. So we're actually sitting at a very high occupancy, our office portfolio overall, is well above 80%. And I think that is very good for this market.
segments.zh: 这是一个缓慢的过程，很艰难。目前是价格战。我们的写字楼组合整体出租率很高，远高于80%，我认为在当前市场下已经很好。

segments.en: Doesn't need to be a bit more of a reason, then, for the office strategy. Maybe repurpose it to retail, for example. That's exactly what we've done for one of our office towers in Hangzhou. So one of them will be exactly. So with services, FNB, nails, hairs, that type of thing.
segments.zh: 那么写字楼策略是否需要调整？比如改作零售。我们在杭州的一栋写字楼正是这样做的。其中一栋将改为服务、餐饮、美甲、美发等业态。

segments.en: Do you get a sense there's some sort of permanence, then, to that? Is that a temporary pivot you're doing, reallocating those assets, or is it something you think? You're prepared to. I think, given the path, the path we just discussed, which may be a longer path, I think this is something that we're really expecting to be more long-term.
segments.zh: 您觉得这种调整是永久性的吗？是临时调整还是长期策略？考虑到刚才讨论的路径可能较长，我们认为这将是长期方向。
